definitions.explanation: A category of Japanese particles that attach to words to add nuances such as limitation, emphasis, inclusion, or approximation. Unlike case particles ({格助詞|かくじょし}) which mark grammatical roles, adverbial particles modify the meaning or scope of the word they attach to.

examples.japanese: 「は」⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{副助詞|ふくじょし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{分類|ぶんるい}される→分類する：25224_bunruisuru⟧。
examples.english: "Wa" is classified as an adverbial particle.

examples.japanese: {副助詞|ふくじょし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧「⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧」⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧「⟦{同様|どうよう}→同様：01654_douyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧」⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦{意味|いみ}→意味：01155_imi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{加|くわ}える→加える：01941_kuwaeru⟧。
examples.english: The adverbial particle "mo" adds the meaning of "also" or "likewise."

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦{文法|ぶんぽう}→文法：01506_bunpou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{副助詞|ふくじょし}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{格助詞|かくじょし}→格助詞：16675_kakujoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{区別|くべつ}→区別：01555_kubetsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧。
examples.english: In Japanese grammar, the distinction between adverbial particles and case particles is important.

notes:
A grammatical term from ⟦{副|ふく}→副〜：03965_fuku⟧ (secondary, adverbial) + ⟦{助詞|じょし}→助詞：03351_joshi⟧ (particle). This is one of the standard particle categories in Japanese school grammar ({学校文法|がっこうぶんぽう}).

COMMON {副助詞|ふくじょし}:
- ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧: topic marker (also contrast)
- ⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: also, even
- ⟦こそ→こそ：12731_koso⟧: emphasis (it is precisely...)
- さえ: even
- ⟦でも→でも：00925_demo⟧: even, or something
- しか: only (with negative)
- ⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧: even, as far as
- ⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧: only, nothing but
- ⟦など→〜など：03095_nado⟧: and so on, such as
- くらい/⟦ぐらい→ぐらい：02900_gurai⟧: about, approximately

OTHER PARTICLE CATEGORIES:
- ⟦{格助詞|かくじょし}→格助詞：16675_kakujoshi⟧: case particles (が, ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧, ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧, で, etc.)
- ⟦{接続助詞|せつぞくじょし}→接続助詞：26609_setsuzokujoshi⟧: conjunctive particles (て, ば, から, etc.)
- ⟦{終助詞|しゅうじょし}→終助詞：26064_shuujoshi⟧: sentence-final particles (⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧, ⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧, ⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧, etc.)
